### Cause
In [rules.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r1/work/src/rules.ts#L286), the inline [`br`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r1/work/src/rules.ts#L286) regex (`/^( {2,}|\\)\n(?!\s*$)/`) matched the hard line break (`{2,}` spaces or `\`) and the newline `\n`, but did not consume leading spaces or tabs at the start of the continuation line, leaving them to be tokenized as leading whitespace in the following [`inlineText`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L990-L1001) token.

### Fix
Updated [`br`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r1/work/src/rules.ts#L286) in [rules.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/geminifull_t6t1_r1/work/src/rules.ts#L286) to `/^( {2,}|\\)\n(?!\s*$)[ \t]*/` so that any spaces or tabs starting the line immediately following a hard line break are consumed as part of the `br` token.
